source_actions.harness: tests/Support/check-phase0-recovery-seed.php (isolated committed copy of the existing business-action fixture)
coverage: financial activation, dated tax rules and opening balances
GL, AP/cash/bank and FIFO inventory posting
quotation issue, written acceptance, conversion and approval
sales-order issue, backorder reservations, replenishment and confirmed deliveries
approved purchase order, official issuance PDF and tax rejection
denied receipt poster, injected mid-transaction failure rollback and receipt retry
cumulative receipt value, FIFO and balanced GRNI journal

backup_restore.restore: pg_restore into the second isolated cluster; applied current migration 168 afterward

persisted_official_pdfs.verification: Decoded bytes after restore; required %PDF prefix; SHA-256 matched both the persisted row and the source manifest for every document. Full per-document hashes are in docs/qa/evidence/phase0-recovery-source.json.

restored_access_controller_checks.method: Invoked the actual owner controllers with authenticated restored actors; router dispatch was not used because it redirected without a browser session.

concurrency.cluster: restored isolated PostgreSQL cluster on 127.0.0.1:55433, after migration 168
races: two processes posted the same pending receipt; both returned successfully and only one source movement persisted
two processes attempted real receipt creation whose combined quantity exceeded the remaining purchase-order quantity; exactly one action was accepted, and it posted through PostPurchaseReceipt once
two processes issued distinct approved purchase orders simultaneously; both persisted unique official numbers and different PDF documents

limits: This is a local isolated single-run recovery acceptance, not a production disaster-recovery exercise or remote backup validation.
The fixture snapshot was taken at migration 167 and the restored database was then migrated to 168; the source cluster remains at the backed-up migration level.
